args: import 'dotenv/config'; import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'; import pg from 'pg'; const url = process.env.ERP_TEST_DATABASE_URL; if (!url) throw new Error('ERP_TEST_DATABASE_URL is required; const pool = new pg.Pool({ connectionString: url }); try { const identity = await pool.query('SELECT current_database() AS name'); console.log('Guarded test database:', identity.rows[0]?.name); if (identity.rows[0]?.name !== 'vyavastha_test') throw new Error('Refusing test writes: current_database() is not exactly vyavastha_test.'); for (const suite of suites) { console.log('\\n=== ' + suite + ' ==='); const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['tests/' + suite], { cwd: process.cwd(), env: process.env, stdio: 'inherit' }); if (result.error) throw result.error; if (result.status !== 0) process.exit(result.status ?? 1); } console.log('SEQUENTIAL SUITES PASSED: ' + suites.length);
